# DNS answers for the CLI tests (--dns-file). Format: name TYPE value

example.com          TXT "v=spf1 include:mail.provider.test include:crm.provider.test mx ~all"
example.com          MX  mx1.example.com
mx1.example.com      A   192.0.2.25
mx1.example.com      AAAA 2001:db8::25

mail.provider.test   TXT "v=spf1 include:_n1.provider.test include:_n2.provider.test ~all"
_n1.provider.test    TXT "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.0/25 ip4:198.51.100.128/25 ~all"
_n2.provider.test    TXT "v=spf1 ip6:2001:db8:100::/48 ~all"

crm.provider.test    TXT "v=spf1 ip4:203.0.113.0/24 exists:%{i}._spf.crm.provider.test -all"

# A domain already publishing flattened records that have drifted.
drift.test           TXT "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.0/24 ip4:203.0.113.0/24 ~all"

broken.test          TXT "v=spf1 include:missing.test -all"

# Cloud-hosted provider: short TTL, single-host addresses.
cloud.provider.test  300 TXT "v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.10 ip4:192.0.2.11 ip4:192.0.2.40 ip4:192.0.2.77 ip4:192.0.2.200 -all"
# Published with --aggressive from cloud.provider.test when it had fewer hosts.
widened.test         TXT "v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.0/24 -all"
